finding: Core-executed ops (elementwise, attention, norm) dominate; integer cores issue 6-14% of cycles
cause: Cluster issues ~0.9 instr/cycle (int+FP); 8.4 instr/elem despite SIMD; sw exp2, FP/int fences. Leading stall candidate: instruction memory at 4 B/cycle (1 instr/cycle per cluster, no icache), consistent with config and F16, not isolated
evidence: sh_simd.inc.c:10-13,79-110; sh_k_silu_mul disasm; SIMULATOR_NOTES #7; cluster_unit.py:209 instr_mem width_log2=2; PROFILE Hardware at a glance
fix_idea: Fewer instr/elem: fuse passes, cheaper exp, no per-iteration address ops

finding: Same ops: no hardware-loop or vector help
cause: No FREP/SSR/Spatz used; sim wires FPU sequencer and SSR ports, FREP timing unverified
fix_idea: Try FREP/SSR inner loops or add exp/vector unit to arch; saving included in C1

finding: bias/residual/add/scale 7.1 ms plus RoPE 3.8 ms are separate tiny ops
cause: No GEMM-epilogue fusion; each op stages in/out and has its own barrier
fix_idea: Fuse bias/RoPE into GEMM output path; residual via accumulate

finding: Vision/prefix GEMMs use 1-10 of 16 clusters; 1-9% of peak
cause: Output tiles only parallelism; no split-K/multicast, one HBM edge; policy deliberate (DSE.md s8). Fix: hypothesis
fix_idea: Split-K with fp32 reduce or 2-D tiles with multicast; spread HBM nodes

finding: Expert GEMMs iDMA-bound (66-93%), RedMulE 10-15%; 312 MB HBM read per step
cause: M=50: X re-read per column tile; tile_k=K (qkv/q/o) gives KT=1, no overlap; 25 qkv tiles on 16 clusters; xmcast unused
fix_idea: Use gemm=xmcast; tk<K so loads overlap; tile counts multiple of 16

finding: Expert weights (~193 MB) re-read every step
cause: Capacity floor: 189.5 MiB weights vs 16 MB TCDM; floor 1.5-2.3 ms/step; only the timing of the stream is fixable (C7)
fix_idea: fp8 weights via DMA cast; spread layer weights over HBM nodes

finding: Barrier after each of 2890 ops; iDMA-bound GEMMs and core-bound row-ops never overlap
cause: No cross-op overlap: next GEMM weights are independent of the row-op, but every call is fenced and refills TCDM
evidence: sh_rowops.inc.c:22-25; sh_gemm.inc.c:115; expert core-bound ~45 ms vs ~21 ms stream
fix_idea: Async op interface: prefetch next weights during row-ops

finding: Barrier wait 21.9% of cluster-time; 22-27% in expert row-ops
cause: Mostly load imbalance: 50 rows -> rpb 4 -> 13 of 16 clusters; 25 tiles on 16; barrier itself ~0.25 us
fix_idea: Split elementwise ops by elements over 16 clusters; tiles divisible by 16

finding: Attention 30 ms; softmax is 56-66% of fused attention and 26% of vision
cause: Softmax on 3 cores between two ~1 us RedMulE calls; vision per-head serial loop, 1 cluster per GEMM; fused unused
fix_idea: fused_attention in vision; cheaper softmax (C1); KV-stationary gave no time gain

finding: Activations round-trip HBM every op: non-GEMM traffic 46% vision, 16% prefix, 10% expert
cause: No L1 residency across ops; per-row 1-D stores ~22-25 cycles/row; time effect: hypothesis (hidden by core-bound ops)
fix_idea: Keep LN/bias/residual chains in TCDM; fuse with C3

finding: Prefix runs 128 padded rows for 65 valid tokens
cause: S_pad=128 for all prefix GEMMs and row-ops; padding rows kept zero but still computed
fix_idea: Row counts from the real prefix length

finding: Big GEMMs move all HBM bytes through 3 of 8 HBM ports (W0-W2); W0 carries 46-67 % and its read link runs at 69-100 % of 64 GB/s
cause: Flat HBM placement from 0xC0000000 (frontends) and no node interleaving (hbm_node_aliase 1): programs fill W0, W1, W2 in order
evidence: profile/hbm_ports.py on the kept logs; softhier_mlir/sim/preload.py:17-18; flex_cluster.py:277-343
fix_idea: Spread weights over all 8 HBM nodes (or interleave nodes); DSE.md HBM placement 1.2-1.6x on S=1024 GEMMs; saving is a hypothesis
